# Feeding the bots with Storyblok

> A tutorial for developers interested in generating an `llms-full.txt` file using a combination of Storyblok and Astro.

This file contains the complete content of the tutorial, converted into markdown.

## Home

Let's start at the beginning, with a photo of a **cat**.

Teaser block

## Generate meta tags

The first step in making a website SEO-ready is adding `meta` tags. For best results, include a combination of standard [HTML](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/meta) and [Open Graph tags](https://ogp.me/).

To *emphasize* the point, here's a quote:

> For best results, include a combination

Explain how to do it with a code snippet:

```
<main {...storyblokEditable(blok)}>
	{
		blok.body?.map((blok) => {
			return <StoryblokComponent blok={blok} />;
		})
	}
	<Fragment set:html={renderedRichText} />
	
</main>
```

The second paragraph will discuss something else. But before that, why not add an H3 heading?
